bull_bear.body: Dividend: INR 2.65/share FY26 (total INR 153cr); capex funded via internal accruals + incremental debt; net debt-to-equity improved to 0.30; ROCE 19.2%, ROE 19.1%; strategic acquisitions (UMEVSPL) and land bank prioritized for long-term capacity
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Commodity price volatility (aluminum, energy); labor cost inflation (35% hikes in key states); delayed price pass-through from OEMs; execution risk across 7+ new plant ramp-ups in FY27; EV demand slowdown; currency fluctuations on export exposure
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident and aggressive; emphasized execution discipline, strategic capex, and long-term EV/CNG leadership; acknowledged near-term margin headwinds but expressed strong customer collaboration on cost pass-through; tone was bullish on India’s auto growth and Uno Minda’s diversification trajectory
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Labor cost inflation (35% in Haryana/Gujarat) is a systemic, underappreciated margin threat beyond commodities; the INR 600cr IVI order represents a 70% revenue uplift from current JV revenues, signaling a major tech leap; 35% of 3-wheeler production is now exported — a hidden export engine; ESG initiatives (differently-abled hiring, CSR centers) are operationalized at scale, not just PR
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Dividend payout ratio held in a narrow band across five years: 12.8% (FY26), 13.7% (FY25), 13.0% (FY24), 13.1% (FY23), 12.0% (FY22).
- Conservative balance sheet: Net Debt to Equity 0.3 in FY26 and FY25 versus 0.2 in FY24-FY22; net worth Rs 7,260 Cr in FY26; current ratio 1.2 and debt service coverage ratio 4.0.
- Returns kept near the high teens: ROCE 19.2% and ROE 19.1% in FY26 (ROCE 18.9%/19.8%/19.2%/15.8% and ROE 17.7%/19.4%/17.2%/12.5% in FY25-FY22), with fixed asset turnover of 4.1.
- Growth is reinvestment-plus-partnership led: a Rs 3,788 Cr project pipeline alongside a "Land bank in major hubs to set up green field project" and a long history of JVs, TLAs and M&A rather than solo builds.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Switches: INR 1,343cr Q4 (+17% YoY), 2W switch exports INR 280cr FY26; Lighting: INR 1,154cr Q4 (+13% YoY), new INR 450cr 2W lighting order; Casting: INR 982cr Q4 (+14% YoY), aluminum pass-through ~4-5%, 4W alloy wheel penetration ~40%, 2W ~70%; Seating: INR 381cr Q4 (+23% FY26), new INR 390cr export orders; Green Mobility: INR 423cr Q4 (+25% YoY), FY26 total INR 1,405cr (CNG: INR 592cr, 2W/3W EV: INR 501cr); Others: INR 1,053cr Q4 (+25% YoY), IVI and sunroof key drivers
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Describes itself as one of the leading manufacturers and suppliers of auto components and systems with leadership across key product segments, "diversified across product divisions (Acoustics, Switches, Castings, Lighting and others), segments (4Ws & 2Ws) and geographies (International & Domestic) and channels (replacement & OEM)".
- Group Turnover (FY25-26) of Rs 250B ($ 2.60 B); Group Strengths slide claims "6 decades of preferred supplier status with major OEMs across all segments".
- Claims the portfolio is "well insulated from any foreseeable market disruptions, with an ICE-EV agnostic product portfolio and constantly increasing kit value, leading to higher wallet share with OEMs".
- Q1 FY27 revenue breakups as given in the deck: Geography India 89% / International 11%; Channel OEM 94% / Aftermarket 6%; Segment 4W 45%, 2W 45%, CV 4%, 3W 3%, OR 3%.
- Built substantially through partnerships: "Mergers and Acquisitions = 7", "Joint Venture Partners = 10", "Technical License Agreements = 8", "Strategic Business Alliance = 2", spanning Japanese, European, American, Korean, Chinese and Taiwanese partners since 1995.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Regulation] Delhi government's EV policy 2.0 flagged: tax relief and incentives on scrapping ICE vehicles, no new 2W registrations of petrol and CNG category from April 2028, and aggregators to transition by April 2030.
- [Macro risk] West Asia conflict cited as causing supply chain pressure and elevated crude oil prices, "resulting in Global inflation and moderating growth outlook".
- [Customer wins] New strategic customer additions for 4W lamps: business nomination from a new global OEM for domestic 4W lighting supply in India, and a second customer won in Indonesia.
- [IP] 252 patents granted, 444 patents filed and 463 design applications filed; won the Best Patent Portfolio Award in the Large - Manufacturing/Engineering (R&D Expenses < Rs 800 crore) category and was recognised among the Top 30 IP-Driven Organizations at the 11th CII Industrial IP Awards 2025.
- [Design/R&D] A separate central R&D and design studio with 423 engineers across 5 locations and "50+ Average R&D Project count per year", plus an Advanced Technology Group focused on technology projects with horizons longer than 3 years and a Global Centre for Embedded & Software Technology.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: Q4 EBITDA margin 11.3% held despite aluminum price inflation (~4-5% pass-through impact), labor cost hikes (35% in Haryana/Gujarat), and commodity volatility; margin guidance of 11%±50bps for FY27 assumes partial price pass-through and operational efficiencies; near-term margin pressure expected from lagged input cost pass-through and startup costs in new plants
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: +17% FY26, FY27 guidance not explicitly stated but implied to be strong; margin: 11% ±50bps; order inflow: multiple multi-crore wins secured (e.g., INR 450cr 2W lighting SOP H2 FY28); capex/commissioning: FY27 capex INR 1,750cr (INR 1,100cr growth), 7/11 projects ramping in FY27, EV powertrain plants (Khed & CSN) commissioning H2 FY27 and Q2 FY28, sunroof plant commissioning end FY27
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: INR 450cr (2-wheeler lighting, SOP H2 FY28); INR 390cr (seating exports to Europe/N. America, SOP FY28); INR 85cr (sunroof, total book >INR 350cr); INR 600cr (IVI platform, SOP Q3 FY29); INR 200cr (2-wheeler silver box display, SOP Q4 FY27)
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: EV powertrain (EDU/DHT) via UMAIPL (Khed & CSN plants); sunroof manufacturing (commissioning end FY27); in-house Android IVI platform (INR 600cr order); 2W silver box display (INR 200cr order); CNG system expansion with 22% PV penetration; export diversification into Europe/N. America
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Uno Minda delivered record Q4 and FY26 revenues and profits driven by broad-based volume growth and EV/CNG adoption, but faces near-term margin pressure from commodity and labor inflation; the company is aggressively scaling EV powertrain and sunroof capabilities with INR 1,750cr FY27 capex, positioning for structural growth despite temporary execution risks.
